wire_reference.generator_source:
import struct,hashlib,json
fields=[b'ZZZZZZZZ.local',b'us-east-1',b'ZZZZZZZZ-bucket',b'ZZZZZZZZ/path',b'ZZZZZZZZ-access',b'ZZZZZZZZ-public-secret',b'ZZZZZZZZ-namespace',b'ZZZZZZZZ-public-ca']
header=bytearray(64)
header[:8]=b'CHS3PF1\0'
struct.pack_into('<HHIHHQ4s7H2xI',header,8,1,64,64+sum(map(len,fields)),1,443,7,bytes([192,0,2,1]),*[len(f) for f in fields[:7]],len(fields[-1]))
frame=bytes(header)+b''.join(fields)
print(json.dumps({'header':list(header),'frame_hex':frame.hex(),'frame_sha256':hashlib.sha256(frame).hexdigest(),'length':len(frame)}))
